List link variants#

get/v1/urls

Requires url.list. Lists variants of linkId with page and limit pagination. The creator of the API key must belong to the link project team.

Parâmetros de consulta

pageinteger

Padrão: 1

limitinteger

Padrão: 20

linkIdstring (uuid)obrigatório
Exemplo
curl -X GET "https://api.trackup.me/v1/urls?linkId=…" \
  -H "X-Api-Key: $TRACKUP_API_KEY"
Respostas
200object

Link variants and total count.

Create a link variant#

post/v1/urls

Requires url.create. Adds a page from the link project as a variant; defaults weight to 1 and isActive to true. A page-owned link rejects additional variants with 409. Sales platform variants require a checkout page and derive the platform from that page. The API key creator must belong to the project team.

Corpo da requisição

linkIdstring (uuid)obrigatório
pageIdstring (uuid)obrigatório
namestringobrigatório
weightinteger
isActiveboolean
salesPlatformIdstring | null (uuid)
Exemplo
curl -X POST "https://api.trackup.me/v1/urls" \
  -H "X-Api-Key: $TRACKUP_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "linkId": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000",
  "pageId": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000",
  "name": "string",
  "weight": 0,
  "isActive": true,
  "salesPlatformId": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}'
Respostas
201object

Created variant.

Update a link variant#

patch/v1/urls/{id}

Requires url.update. Updates the supplied fields. Repointing the variant of a page-owned link is rejected with 409. The API key creator must belong to the link project team.

Parâmetros de caminho

idstringobrigatório

Variant identifier.

Corpo da requisição

pageIdstring (uuid)
namestring
weightinteger
isActiveboolean
salesPlatformIdstring | null (uuid)
Exemplo
curl -X PATCH "https://api.trackup.me/v1/urls/{id}" \
  -H "X-Api-Key: $TRACKUP_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "pageId": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000",
  "name": "string",
  "weight": 0,
  "isActive": true,
  "salesPlatformId": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}'
Respostas
200object

Updated variant; includes updatedAt rather than createdAt.

Delete a link variant#

delete/v1/urls/{id}

Requires url.delete. Soft-deletes a variant. Non-traffic-source links reject deleting their only variant or reducing an A/B test below two variants with 409. The API key creator must belong to the link project team.

Parâmetros de caminho

idstringobrigatório

Variant identifier.

Exemplo
curl -X DELETE "https://api.trackup.me/v1/urls/{id}" \
  -H "X-Api-Key: $TRACKUP_API_KEY"
Respostas
200object

Variant deleted.
